feats.title: Auspicious Lineage
feats.description: When you use your memory of a thousand lifetimes racial power, you add 1d8 to the triggering roll, instead of 1d6.

feats.title: Battle Intuition
feats.description: You can use your *Wisdom* in place of your Dexterity to determine your initiative bonus. Additionally, you gain a +2 feat bonus to initiative checks.

feats.title: Heavenly Heritage
feats.description: When you take cold damage or fire damage, you gain a number of temporary hit points equal to your *Wisdom*.

feats.title: Immortal Skill
feats.description: When using memory of a thousand lifetimes to modify a skill check or ability check, you treat a result that is lower than the average for the die you roll—3 for d6 or 4 for d8—as the average.

feats.title: Potent Rebirth
feats.description: When you drop to 0 hit points or fewer, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls until the end of the encounter.

feats.title: Radiant Power
feats.description: When you make an implement attack, you can take a -2 penalty to the attack roll. If you do so and the attack hits, it deals 2 extra radiant damage. The extra radiant damage increases to 4 at 11th level and 6 at 21st level.

feats.title: Upright Revival
feats.description: If you drop to 0 or fewer hit points and fall unconscious, when you regain 1 or more hit points and become conscious, you stand and shift 1 square as a free action.
